title: Session close after the twenty-seventh round and the black hole: main 29f74569, everything pushed; what the owner has not yet seen
context: The owner closes the session ('sync, commit and push, then we will /clear') after the twenty-seventh notes (2026-10-06-session-sync-twenty-seventh-notes-shipped) and the accretion disk (2026-10-06-the-black-hole-not-far).
